main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x excess 5-bar return, non-overlapping grid, forecast > 0, pooled
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 to confirm (with check difference > 0), t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-bar return above minus below the median positive forecast

decided_by: The main measure's t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: The coin's mean 5-bar return is taken over the same non-overlapping grid (positions 0, 5, 10, ... of each window, with t+5 inside the window) across all its windows; the supporting check compares cases strictly above and strictly below the median positive forecast, ties left out; fewer than 30 cases gives 'not observable'.
